Driving

BOOST

Build it in a bend. Spend it on an exit.

Build it in a bend. Spend it on an exit.

What it does

BOOST spends stored charge for extra acceleration and speed.

How to do it

DRIFT to recharge. Slide to BOOST when the car has a useful path ahead. The empty cue tells you the charge is gone.

Why use it

A well-timed burst turns a clean corner exit into speed down the next section.

Timing

Straighten enough to keep the burst on the road. Save charge if the next tight turn would force you to brake immediately.

Advanced

BOOST POWER controls the strength; BOOST TANK controls duration. OVERCHARGE burns first as KICK, then ordinary BOOST continues.

Practise it

Try Airport. Tutorials give you a guided starting point.
